name: orquesta-v5
description: Orquesta V5 desktop platform for durable multi-agent work.

scripts.test:load: npm run test:load --workspace @orquesta/execution-kernel && npm run test:load --workspace @orquesta/local-core && npm --prefix apps/orquesta-desktop-next run test:load
scripts.check: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:desktop-p0 && npm run test:product-boundary && npm run test:state-atomic && npm run test:task-controller && npm run test:skill-sync && npm run test:desktop-launch && npm run test:skill-runtime && npm run check:encoding && npm run check:skill:all
scripts.test:desktop-p0: npm --prefix apps/orquesta-desktop-next run test && npm --prefix apps/orquesta-desktop-next run test:runtime && npm --prefix apps/orquesta-desktop-next run test:native-contract
scripts.typecheck:p2-runtime: npm run typecheck --workspace @orquesta/local-core && npm --prefix apps/orquesta-desktop-next run typecheck:runtime
scripts.test:product-boundary: npm run typecheck:p2-runtime && node scripts/product-boundary-check.js && node --test scripts/product-boundary-check.test.js scripts/desktop-workspace-boundary.test.js
